geometry.polygon: long lateral diagonal (back heel → front knee → side ribs → top hand) over a wide base triangle
geometry.summary: From a wide Warrior II stance, bend the front knee over the front ankle, tip the torso over the front thigh, and place the bottom hand on the floor, a block, or the front shin. Reach the top arm overhead into one long side-body line from back heel through outer ribs to fingertips. Keep the chest open toward the side/ceiling; never collapse the front knee inward.
geometry.svg_hint: wide base; bent front knee; angled torso; bottom hand support; top arm long diagonal

reaction.name: Solid → sky
reaction.summary: School metaphor: the strong lateral stretch first makes the body feel like a hard edge; then attention softens that edge into spaciousness felt in all directions at once (not a medical or biochemical claim).

breath.lands_in: long side body (bottom waist through top ribs) then soft belly
breath.cue: Inhale lengthen the top arm and outer side; exhale settle weight into the back heel and front foot without collapsing the chest.

orientation.cue: Back heel heavy; front knee tracks over second toe; torso tips over front thigh while chest stays open to the side.
orientation.gravity: Load both feet; bottom hand is a light prop, not a dump of the whole torso.
orientation.gaze: Soft toward the top hand or forward along the cheek if the neck complains.
orientation.degrees_hint: Front thigh approaching parallel when available; top arm continues the side-body line (~one long diagonal).

attention.primary: Whole-body field as space in all six directions at once (front, back, left, right, above, below)
attention.secondary: Long outer-side line from back heel to top fingertips

adiyogi.verse_paraphrase: In your own body, contemplate space in every direction at the same time. When the mind stops fabricating solid boundaries, experience unfolds as space.
adiyogi.method_summary: While holding the shape (or seated after), sense the whole body at once and let attention spread evenly through front, back, sides, above, and below. Soften the idea of a hard body-edge; rest as if inner and outer space were the same field. Do not force a visualization or suppress thoughts.

honesty.disclosure: This asana↔method link is a School of 112 Doorways teaching device, not ancient canon. Extended Side Angle and VBT dharana 014 are paired by school index so students can braid a strong side-body geometry with an omnidirectional space contemplation.
honesty.notes: Experiential resonance (not canon): the pose’s vivid one-sided stretch can highlight the habit of locating awareness in a solid edge; dharana 014 then invites space in all directions at once. Kept as school_device because the serial index pairing is the School’s primary rule.

safety.pain_rule: Pain is information. Pause, regress, or exit. Never push through sharp pain.
safety.open_seat_alternate: Hands-on-hips side bend in a shorter stance, or Warrior II with soft side stretch; use a block under the bottom hand rather than reaching the floor.
safety.contraindication_notes: General practice caution only; not medical advice. Ease off if front knee, hip, or neck complains; shorten stance and raise the bottom hand.

sources.label: Vijñāna Bhairava Tantra — Dhāraṇā 14 (body as space in all directions)
sources.ref: VBh ~43 / dharana 014; paraphrase from public commentary summary

beats.title: Name the door
beats.script: Door D-014: Extended Side Angle — Utthita Parsvakonasana. One long side-body line over a wide base.

beats.title: Geometry
beats.script: Wide stance. Bend the front knee over the ankle. Tip the torso over the front thigh. Bottom hand to floor, block, or shin. Top arm reaches long overhead.

beats.title: Orientation
beats.script: Back heel heavy. Front knee tracks over the second toe. Bottom hand props lightly. Chest opens to the side, not folded down.

beats.title: Breath
beats.script: Inhale four counts to lengthen the top side. Exhale six counts into both feet. Six cycles. Soften if the breath shortens.

beats.title: Attention
beats.script: Feel the long outer side — then also front, back, other side, above, and below. Attention fills the whole body-field at once.

beats.title: Reaction cue
beats.script: School cue: solid edge softens toward sky. The stretch stays; the sense of a hard body-boundary can loosen.

beats.title: Adiyogi thread
beats.script: VBT dharana 014, safe form: in this body, contemplate space in all directions at once. Rest when constructs of solidity quiet.

beats.title: Exit / integrate
beats.script: Inhale to lift the torso. Straighten the front leg. Step back to standing. Notice residual space-sense before the next shape.
